verdict.rationale: Simular documents a REST API with specific endpoints (`GET /v1/agents/events`, `POST /v1/agents/approve`, `GET /v1/agents/machines`) on a developer docs site with an llms.txt index. It also offers runnable, cloneable example scripts and copy-paste setup commands. Nothing shows the API reference is interactive (no try-it console or playground), and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, so a generated interactive reference looks unlikely. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it API reference, a published OpenAPI spec, runnable examples embedded in the API reference, and independent corroboration.
